les.title: 🏋 Drill: basic mates engine ke against
les.sub: Queen, rook aur seedhi se mate, engine poori taakat se bachta hai
yaad: Box chhota karo, king saath lao, kinare par mate.
Queen se mate karte waqt stalemate se bacho.

steps.h: Drill: engine ke against mate karo
steps.md:
Yeh lesson nahi, **practice** hai. Jo mates tumne seekhe (queen, rook, do rooks ki seedhi), unhe ab **engine ke against** karna hai. Engine har baar sabse lambi bachne wali chaal chalega.

- Pehle **practice**: galti ho to ↶ Wapas, 💡 hint, ↺ shuru se.
- Phir **test**: 5 naye positions, **ek hi koshish**, hint nahi. **4/5** par agla lesson khulega.

Yaad rakho: **stalemate = draw**. Har chaal se pehle dekho ki opponent king ke paas chaal bachi hai ya nahi.

steps.why: Queen knight ki doori par rakh kar box chhota karo, phir king paas lao. Stalemate se bacho!

les.title: 🏋 Drill: king + pawn, jeeto aur bachao
les.sub: Opposition aur key squares engine ke against
yaad: King pawn ke aage = jeet ka raasta.
Defend karte waqt king pawn ke saamne, opposition lo.

steps.h: Drill: king + pawn, dono taraf se
steps.md:
Opposition aur key squares ab **engine ke against**.

- Kuch positions mein tum **jeetoge** (pawn queen banao).
- Kuch mein tum **defend** karoge (draw bachao).

Practice ke baad test: 5 naye positions, ek koshish, **4/5** chahiye.

steps.why: King pawn ke aage, key squares par. Kings aamne-saamne ho to opposition jiske paas, woh jeetta hai.

les.title: 🏋 Drill: bishop + knight mate (GM level)
les.sub: Sabse mushkil basic mate, engine ke against
yaad: Mate bishop ke colour wale corner mein.
Knight W shape mein, bishop diagonal band kare, king paas.

steps.h: Naya: bishop + knight se mate kaise
steps.md:
Pichle lesson mein seekha: K+B+N vs K **jeet** hai, mate sirf **bishop ke colour wale corner** mein. Ab technique:

1. **Teeno saath**: apna king dushman king ke paas, bishop aur knight beech mein squares band karte hain.
2. Dushman king **galat corner** mein ho to use kinare ke saath **sahi corner** ki taraf dhakelo. Knight ek **W** shape mein chalta hai (jaise `Nf7-e5-d7-c5`), bishop diagonal band karta hai.
3. Sahi corner ke paas: king ko corner mein band karo, bishop se aakhri check.

Yeh **lamba** hai (30 chaal tak). Isliye positions mein dushman king pehle se kinare par hai. Stalemate se bacho.
